description: Suggests appropriate ICD-10 diagnosis codes based on a finalized SOAP note and therapy discipline.

input_variables.name: input
input_variables.description: The finalized SOAP note as JSON

input_variables.name: icdCodeList
input_variables.description: Comma-separated list of ICD-10 codes relevant to the therapy discipline

input_variables.name: discipline
input_variables.description: The therapy discipline (e.g. OccupationalTherapy, PhysicalTherapy, Psychotherapy)
